title: Equil: TBR consistent fail, possible connection issue.
body:
```
Equil FW 5.3
AAPS 3.3.0-dev-b
```

As the clip below shows, Temp Basal Rate fails to be set, with the pump falling back to default basal rates. 
The issue can persist even by retrying form the Loop plugin. 
Same bug presents itself even on earlier objectives when having to confirm the suggested temp basal rates manually. 

https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/98546700/055139e7-0f8e-4359-b352-cb49b3fdfda5

Frequency of this happening is often more than 50% of the times. Even cancelling TBR might fail. 

![WhatsApp Image 2024-05-29 at 13 42 06_01a92ae4](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/98546700/813d3d78-70c2-48d1-8380-4bbcf5485f23)

Not sure if this could be a driver / BT connection error, even bolusing gave me twice this error in the last 2 days 

![WhatsApp Image 2024-06-03 at 19 45 26_5cf06eb8](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/98546700/38c71098-22bf-4326-913b-ce7930df6116)

Logs show 
```
12:43:22.041 [binder:6277_B] D/PUMPCOMM: [EquilBLE.writeData():302]: indexData error 
```

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/15537710/AndroidAPS.log)

Issue was confirmed by other people from my same hospital using Equil.
